capabilities: pin the Daily Note of the current day
unpin Daily Notes of past and future days
install through BRAT as a beta plugin
extras: Installed via BRAT rather than the community plugin store; only works with the default Daily Note format YYYY-MM-DD.
problem: Obsidian does not automatically keep the current Daily Note pinned, so past and future Daily Notes can stay pinned and clutter the tab bar.
summary: Automation plugin that pins the current day's Daily Note and unpins Daily Notes of past and future days.
